title: A Spectral Criterion for Emergent Gravity
summary: We study long-range tensor response and its coupling to matter through sourced spectral equations on fixed spacetime. For a response with a positive spectral representation, the weight at zero is extracted by an infrared limit. At an isolated critical mode, this weight is determined by the propagation slope and the projection of the source onto the critical space. Deriving the kernel and source maps from the same equations allows the residue to be followed through channel elimination and finite approximation.
